tiers.name: daily
tiers.cadence: oldest reading first; up to 250 per run via Blockscout, 50 via Moralis

methodology: Top-10 wallets after excluding burn and labelled exchange/staking/LP/bridge/treasury wallets (unlabelled contracts kept). Stablecoins, tokenized RWAs, exchange tokens, liquid-staking and wrapped tokens excluded by category. Values over 100% discarded.
